headline: Anthropic restricts, then eases, Claude's video game cloning block
summary: Anthropic updated Claude and Claude Code to stop recreating existing video games, after users said the block also caught legitimate reverse-engineering tasks. Days later Anthropic loosened the restriction to cut false positives for game developers, while users can still use Claude to design original or same-genre games.
